newsitem.title: USA: Marathon says most USG gas, oil cuts back.
newsitem.headline: Marathon says most USG gas, oil cuts back.

text.p: USX-Marathon Group said Tuesday that most of the U.S. Gulf natural gas and crude production shut this week as a precaution against Tropical Storm Josephine has been restored.
"I'm sure most of it is back today. We started putting people out there yesterday afternoon," a company spokesman said.
About 50,000 gross barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil and 150 million gross cubic feet of natural gas were shut-in after nine fields were closed ahead of the storm.

Josephine was downgraded overnight from a tropical storm, as it dissipated when it moved across Florida. At 0500 EDT, the storm was located 50 miles southeast of Savannah, Georgia, moving east-northeast at 25 mph, with winds of about 50 mph.
